The '''Almanian sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the sector included [[Almania]]. Hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Almanian Uprising]] of [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the sector was [[Almanian sector invasion|invaded]] by an Almanian army [[General/Legends|general]] named [[Kueller (general)|Kueller]].<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>
